exposure: ultrasound estimated percentile weight (EPW) at 35 weeks
outcome: large for gestational age (LGA) at term delivery
finding: The predictive ability of ultrasound estimated fetal weight at 35 weeks to detect LGA infants is significantly greater for FMF and MSUH NC standards, while customized standards show significantly greater APO detection rates, and a shorter ultrasound-delivery interval improves prediction rates.
gest_age: 35 weeks (for ultrasound assessment) and term delivery (for outcome assessment)
